### Transducer
A transducer is an electronic device that converts a physical quantity (non-electrical) into a proportional electrical signal (voltage, current, resistance, etc.).

### Difference Between Active and Passive Transducers

| Feature | Active Transducer | Passive Transducer |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Power Source** | Self-generating; does not require an external power supply. | Requires an external DC/AC excitation source to operate. |
| **Energy Conversion** | Converts non-electrical energy directly into electrical energy. | Modifies the applied external electrical power based on the physical parameter. |
| **Examples** | Thermocouple, Piezoelectric crystal, Photovoltaic cell. | LVDT, Thermistor, Photoconductive cell, Strain gauge. |
proTip: Active transducers generate their own electricity (piezo/ thermocouples), while passive ones merely modulate an external source (resistance/inductance changes).
